_about: Every word the page shows that is not the story (story.json), a name in another data file, or a Codex line (written by crates/core/src/codex.rs from the game's numbers). Mechanical text here (controls, hints, buttons) carries no voice. {placeholders} are filled by the core or the page.
title: Long Time Comin'
subtitle: Convicted in 2081. Sent back to stop yourself. Stranded in 2031.
holding_text: A bench. A lamp. A clerk who records every return. Spend the Clemency you earned, then go back into the years.
no_counts: The Tribunal releases one charge each time you die.
map_hint: Tab, M, or Esc closes this map. Solid lines lead forward. Dashed lines are optional fights with the reward shown.
abandon_confirm: Abandon the run? The Tribunal counts this as a death.
hint_arrival: W A S D move · mouse aims · hold left mouse to fire · Space jumps · Shift dashes · walk into the lit gate to leave
hint_fight: Enemy orbs hurt on contact. Jump over ground waves. You cannot be hit during the opening part of a dash.
hint_cleared: Area clear. Blue gates advance the story. Orange gates lead to harder optional fights and the reward shown.
hint_rest: Choose one reward. Press E at the left pedestal for health or the right for its item. The other will be lost. The boss waits beyond the gate.
callout_fell: FELL: RETURNED TO THE LAST FLOOR
callout_jump_full: ALREADY AT FOUR JUMPS: HEALTH RESTORED
no_webgl: This browser has no WebGL 2, which the game needs to draw.
controls: Aim. The camera turns with it.
Fire the gun you carry. The Ripsaw throws a blade on each click and, held, revs the blades it has lodged.
The gun's second fire: the Carbine's burst, the Scattergun's slug, the Launcher's cluster, the Ripsaw's shatter. Each has its own cooldown.
Jump. Press again in the air for each further jump you have, up to {max_jumps}.
Dash {dash_distance} m in {dash_time} s. No damage for the first {dash_iframes} s. Uses a charge; each recharges in {dash_recharge} s.
Bound Over: dash and jump together, Shift first or on the same press, for a long, low leap that keeps the dash's speed.
Take a gun from the floor within {pickup_reach} m. Your old gun is left in its place.
Grappling hook, once the Writ of Reach is bought. Range {grapple_range} m.
Parry, once Objection is bought. Lasts {parry_window} s and turns back gold orbs.
Injunction, once bought: a wall {wall_width} m wide for {wall_time} s that breaks blue orbs.
Grab an enemy at half health or less, near and in front of you; G again throws it along your aim for {throw_damage} damage to what it hits.
Stop time, once the Defendant is beaten: {stop} s at first. Enemies, orbs and your own shots hold still until it resumes.
Lay a Bench, once bought: a {bench_size} m plank for {bench_time} s, under you in the air or where you aim on the ground. You stand on it; shots and orbs pass through it.
Left mouse, Q, E, R, F
With the trumpet out, at the Idiot God's heart: its five notes, low to high. Play each as it reaches the line.
Ground pound, once Gavel Drop is bought: straight down at {pound_speed} m/s, a shockwave of {pound_damage} damage within {pound_radius} m where you land, and a bounce back up.
Open or close the map. The game is paused while it is open.
credit: Made by Sam Gilson. Art drawn in TikZ.
save_note: Your record is kept in this browser.
first_grant: The court grants {n} Clemency for your first return.
sentence_bonus_applied: Your sentence adds {n}% to the Clemency you earn.
sentence_bonus: Sentence bonus: +{n}% Clemency earned (5% for each 10 years).
callout_pierce: PIERCING ROUNDS: SHOTS PASS THROUGH ONE MORE ENEMY
callout_pulse: DASH PULSE: DASHING CLEARS NEARBY ORBS
callout_mend: MENDING PARRY: TURNED ORBS HEAL YOU
prompt_choose: E: take {thing}. The other choice here is lost.
hint_landing: Choose one supply reward with E. The other will be lost. Stand on a glowing grate to ride its updraft.
callout_survive: INVULNERABLE. SURVIVE UNTIL THE PHASE ENDS.
hint_vestibule: Choose one reward with E. The other is lost. The grey men use cover and coordinated fire. Watch your flanks.
hint_tank: Its hull and turret turn shots aside. Get behind it and break the glowing weak points.
rush_line: Boss rush complete. Completions: {n}. Clemency from this run has been added to your record.
hint_gullet: Cross a gold frame to emerge from its partner. Shots pass through too. Falling off an edge brings you back from above.
hint_song: Listen to the dancers' five-note phrase. Repeat it with left click, Q, E, R, and F as each note reaches the line. Keep moving while the god fires.
mission_note: One continuous journey, 2031 to 2081. No return to the Holding. Then home.
hint_mission: The last sentence: fight through all four eras without returning to the Holding. More enemies attack together, with new patterns.
try_chumbles_title: Practise the Chumbles fight from a chosen phase (nothing is saved)
timeline_text: Two ways out of 2056. Pick a year to start a run there; past the house, a run follows the timeline it is on.
callout_summons: THE SUMMONS RISES FROM THE LAKE
hint_course: Cross to the gate at the far end. The water drowns you: a mooring post you have reached is where it returns you. Shift + Space together: Bound Over. V: a Bench to stand on.
hint_oak: Climb: hook each ring and come down on the shelf above. Its eye opens just over you. At the crown, what it calls.
hint_rotten: Rotten timber. Hook the ring over it, then press C in the air: the ground pound breaks it and you drop through.
callout_course_cleared: ALL DOWN: THE WAY ON IS OPEN
hint_eraser: Stand in the lit pylon's ring to charge the Eraser. Your older self cannot be hurt here: hold on until it fires.
hint_maelstrom: Under the water: Space again to swim up. The current pulls you toward the eye.
hint_fleet: Seven ships, seven crews. Fell a ship's crew and she strikes her colours; when all seven have struck, the way on opens at the flagship's bow. Their masts and yards take the hook.
hint_hurricane: The rain slants before a gust shoves you; lightning marks its circle first. Work forward, ship to ship, to the flagship's bow.
hint_halls: The Vault's machines wake as you pass. Fell them all and the far door opens.
callout_dragon_free: The chain breaks. The dragon is free!
hint_dragon: The dragon can't be hurt on its chain. Shoot the three brass locks at the mainmast's foot to free it, then bring it down.
